description: The `qfai` preset, for a Renovate whose administrator has allow-listed the regeneration command.

Everything comes from `qfai`; this file changes exactly one thing — a `qfai` bump automerges too. That is only sound once `npx --yes qfai@… init --force` is permitted by `allowedCommands`, because it is that command running inside the update branch that puts the regenerated assistant tree into the same pull request. Extend this preset only after the command is allow-listed; before then the base preset is the correct one, and the difference between them is whether a stale assistant tree can reach the default branch without anyone looking.

packageRules.description: Undoes the base preset's hold on `qfai`, and nothing else — the regeneration task, its file filters and the pull-request note are inherited unchanged.
